case.summary: Case HHG-008 was opened on 2016-12-20 following a report from customer C13171 disputing transaction 3558054 for $55.68 on card C13171-K2. Graph analysis and the closed-case classifier assigned a fraud probability of 0.99 with a verdict of fraud under the card_not_present_new_device pattern. The investigation identified a 3-transaction fraudulent episode totaling $166.97 between 2016-12-19 21:48:32 and 2016-12-19 22:08:56. Customer validation confirmed the denial, leading to final recommended actions under Policy R2.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Assumed the customer denies making transaction 3558054 and the related activity and still holds the card, because the evidence leans towards fraud (probability 0.99 >= 0.50; strongest point: Closed-case classifier scores flagged txn 3558054 at 1.00 (learned from the bank's confirmed/cleared cases; the bank risk score 0.38 is not used as a verdict)).
